description: Pipeline Events Timeline — shows the sequence of events during workflow generation, including phase durations, token usage, and validation error changes, helping developers understand and debug the generation pipeline.

groups.name: Pipeline Events Timeline
groups.description: Users need a chronological timeline of generation pipeline events showing what happened during each phase of workflow generation.

assertions.description: Users can identify the Pipeline Events timeline and understand its purpose as a tool for viewing generation pipeline activity
Each event row displays a phase badge indicating which pipeline stage (discovery, generation, validation, fixing, hardening, reflection) the event belongs to
Each event row shows a formatted timestamp so users can understand when each pipeline phase occurred and correlate events with other system activity

groups.name: Per-Event Metrics
groups.description: Users need to see per-event metrics including duration in milliseconds, token counts, and validation error deltas to identify bottlenecks and measure improvement.

assertions.description: Each event displays its duration in milliseconds so users can identify which pipeline phases are slowest and optimize accordingly
Each event displays token usage counts so users can track LLM consumption per pipeline phase and identify expensive operations
Each event displays validation error deltas using arrow notation to show whether the phase reduced or increased errors

target.label: Validation error delta with arrow notation

groups.name: Phase Color Coding
groups.description: Each pipeline phase is color-coded for quick identification: blue for discovery, green for generation, yellow for validation, orange for fixing, purple for hardening, cyan for reflection.

assertions.description: Pipeline phase badges display distinct color-coded dots (blue, green, yellow, orange, purple, cyan) so users can visually distinguish phases at a glance in the timeline

target.label: Phase color dots in event rows

groups.name: Loading and Empty States
groups.description: Empty and loading states communicate pipeline status clearly.

assertions.description: Users see a loading indicator while pipeline event data is being fetched, preventing confusion about a blank timeline
Users see an informative empty state when no pipeline events have been recorded yet, explaining that events appear after workflow generation runs

groups.name: Event Data Rendering
groups.description: Each event row must accurately render the event type, phase, timestamp (HH:mm:ss format), duration in milliseconds, token count, and validation error delta from the API response.

assertions.description: Each event shows a timestamp formatted as HH:mm:ss derived from the created_at ISO datetime
assertions.expected: HH:mm:ss format derived from ISO 8601 created_at

assertions.description: Events with duration_ms show the value suffixed with 'ms' (e.g. '1234ms')
When both validation_errors_before and validation_errors_after are present, the event shows 'errors: N → M' indicating how validation errors changed during that phase
assertions.expected: Format 'errors: N → M' where N=validation_errors_before, M=validation_errors_after

groups.name: Timeline Behavior
groups.description: The timeline is scrollable when events exceed the visible area (max-h-96), events are ordered chronologically by created_at, and the timeline connector lines visually link sequential events.

assertions.description: When more events exist than fit in the visible area, the container scrolls vertically to reveal additional events
assertions.precondition: More events exist than fit in the max-h-96 container

assertions.description: Events are displayed in chronological order (oldest first, newest last) matching the pipeline execution sequence
assertions.precondition: Multiple events exist for the task run

groups.name: Required Timeline Elements
groups.description: Each event row must contain a phase color dot, event type label, and timeline connector line. The header must show the Zap icon.

assertions.description: Each event has a colored phase indicator dot (2.5x2.5 rounded circle) visually identifying the pipeline phase

metadata.author: Joshua Spinak
preconditions: Requires at least one workflow generation with instrumented generator — generation_pipeline_events table must have entries
Events are per-task-run — the component needs a task_run_id from execution context or props
Empty state is valid when no generations have occurred since instrumentation was added
backendDependencies: GET /graph/pipeline-events?task_run_id=<id> — returns PipelineEvent[] ordered by created_at
